brief:
Israeli forces and settlers conducted attacks and raids in Nablus, Shehab Wire reported. The operations targeted the occupied West Bank city, with forces entering multiple neighborhoods and engaging in confrontations with Palestinian residents during the incursions.

The raids reflect an escalating pattern of military and settler operations across Palestinian towns in the West Bank. Residents reported clashes and property damage during the operations, though specific casualty figures and a complete account of affected areas remained unclear in initial reports. Such incursions have become a recurring occurrence in Nablus and surrounding municipalities.
